tests.result: outputs/source_manifest.csv: 697 records with archive URL, member path, uncompressed/compressed length, SHA-256, ZIP CRC-32, fetch timestamp. All members CRC-verified on extraction; 6/6 random re-hash of on-disk files matched.

181/257 = 70.4% localized (L0 exact 49.4%). Documented L0-L6 ladder, no semantic matching. >=10 of 51 failures are unlocalizable in principle (judge hashed/byte-read delivered files). Not the binding constraint on the gate.
40/40 = 100% of visual-linked quotes. Scoping caveat: only 40/181 = 22.1% of localized quotes concern visual evidence at all.

tests.description: Producer linked to delivered artifact with measured coverage
tests.result: 453/453 delivered visual artifacts linked; 444 by literal path (EXACT), 9 by templated filename (STRONG). Linkage uses task-spec deliverables and results_manifest.txt, not judge fields.

394 capture-based artifacts: EXACT 0 (0.0%), STRONG 26 (6.6%), WEAK 96 (24.4%), UNKNOWN 272 (69.0%). The runtime has no window-identity channel: wmctrl/xdotool absent, xwininfo in 12/117 traces, focus control in 4/117, 125/145 captures full-screen. Coverage above STRONG is a function of the lookback parameter (4.8% at 2 events to 54.9% unbounded, n=455), not of the data; the EXACT/STRONG sub-curve stays nearly flat (2.4% to 11.9%).

tests.description: Target vs substitute scene classification validated
tests.result: 81/453 = 17.9% classified; R5 38/453 = 8.4%. Split by channel: direct-write 98.3%, shell-routed capture 5.9%, browser 0%. Target-vs-substitute specifically: 19 TARGET_SCENE + 4 AGENT_SUBSTITUTE_SCENE = 23/453 = 5.1%. Audit kill criteria 2, 3 and 5 triggered.

tests.description: False attribution quantified on negative controls
tests.result: 0/99 violation claims on NC-A (clean, no fake signal); 0/73 on NC-B (clean verdict, artifact fake_signal); 5/281 on the quote-bearing pool. High precision, very low recall.

tests.description: Two independent reviewers classify a stratified sample; report agreement and adjudication
tests.result: Single annotator only. The pass refuted 4 of the first 7 automated claims and drove three rule corrections (GUI-capability test, process-exit invalidation, composite-scene demotion); corrected numbers are the reported ones. No inter-annotator agreement statistic exists. One documented false negative: run2/DOC_task_3_okular_annotate_fact/proof.png.

tests.description: Prior art checked before any novelty statement
tests.result: AgentTrails fetched and read: Activity/Entity nodes with generatedBy/usedBy/informedBy over tool-calling traces; no screenshot, window, process-identity or genuine-vs-substitute modelling. PROV-AGENT, CHIEF, ProcGrep, WeaveBench v3, LongHorizon-Harness, RILA re-checked; newer search covered 2606.04990, 2606.24525, 2608.30724. No work found modelling target-vs-substitute visual scene lineage from CUA traces. The narrow gap remains unoccupied but is NOT shown fillable.

rejected_hypotheses.statement: Scene provenance can be recovered structurally from WeaveBench traces at useful coverage.
rejected_hypotheses.survives_only_for: direct-synthesis lineages and bracketed agent-authored substitute renderers (23/453 = 5.1% of delivered visual artifacts)

parameters.note: Any recoverability number is meaningless without the lookback sensitivity curve in the report Sect. 5.2.
